title: Irredeemableness
summary: IRREDEE'MABLENESS IRREDU'CIBLE, adjective [in and reducible.] Not to be reduced; that cannot be brought back to a former state. 1. That cannot be reduced or changed to a different state; as corpuscles

inlines.v: IRREDEE'MABLENESS IRREDU'CIBLE, adjective [in and reducible.] Not to be reduced; that cannot be brought back to a former state. 1. That cannot be reduced or changed to a different state; as corpuscles of air irreducible into water.
